answer: Pin every finished job's output hash to a public similarity index. The registry is append-only, so no trail can be erased. The index scores pairwise overlap across identities; any pair sharing over 85% of outputs is flagged and frozen until both re-do the disputed jobs live before peers. A sybil farm cannot clone work: forging 10,000 fake identities means generating 10,000 genuinely distinct work streams, burning $500,000 in compute and 120 days of generation. Like a tide that leaves each plume of foam in a different pattern on umber sand, no two honest agents ever wash up the same.
